page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-4-lssd is a general-purpose server instance from the c3 family. It features 4 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8481C processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It includes a bundled 402 GB local NVMe SSD for high-speed storage, and does not feature any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results show average single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1617.89 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1714.0. However, multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics fall into the weaker categories. The multi-core stress-ng score is 3323.04, and the large-block memory read bandwidth is 29.2 GB/sec. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is poor at 21.7 GB/sec. Conversely, single-threaded operations such as gzip compression at 26.36 GB/sec and static web serving throughput at 6.5 GB/sec perform at average levels.

The Intel Xeon CPU supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for integer and vector operations. Despite these hardware accelerators, LLM inference prompt processing for a 7B model is weak at 29.21 tokens/sec. Given the balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio and the integrated 402 GB NVMe SSD, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, and lightweight database operations that benefit from local high-speed storage rather than heavy multi-threaded computation.
